### Why this happens
- **Different “dates” mean different things**
  - **Git first-add date**: When the file was added to this repo. Your file shows 2025‑07‑10 because it was introduced here then (history before that isn’t in this repo).
  - **Header date in the doc**: Authorship/version date the author wrote in the file (Jan 10, 2025).
  - **Filesystem creation date**: When the file was created on this machine (often when copied/moved).
- **History was (re)introduced**
  - If a file was authored earlier elsewhere and later copied into this repo, Git’s “creation” date becomes the import date.
- **Timezone/clock differences**
  - Git timestamps include offsets (e.g., -05:00), which can make dates look “off” across systems even when they’re the same instant.

### How to stop “incorrect” dates
- **Define the standard**:
  - “Created” (authorship): use the file’s header/front‑matter date.
  - “Added to repo”: use Git’s earliest author date for the file.
  - Publish both when needed; always use ISO 8601 UTC (e.g., 2025-01-10T00:00:00Z).
- **Optional guardrails**:
  - Add front‑matter `created:` and `lastUpdated:` fields in Markdown.
  - Pre-commit check to validate ISO dates and prevent local timezone drift.

- Repo is not shallow; earliest commit adding this file is 2025‑07‑10 and matches the add event. Header date reflects earlier authorship elsewhere.

        "contents": "export async function getEventsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n) {\n\n\n\t\t...\n\n\n\t\t// After getting the timeSeriesAggregation, add a normalization step for the dates\n\t\tconst normalizedTimeSeriesData =\n\t\t\ttimeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear?.values.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t// Check if the date appears to be missing the millennium or is in the future\n\t\t\t\tif (item.$key \u0026\u0026 typeof item.$key === \"string\") {\n\t\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst dateStr = item.$key;\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst parsedDate = new Date(dateStr);\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst year = parsedDate.getFullYear();\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Filter out future dates beyond next year (allow some buffer)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif (year \u003e currentYear + 1) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(&#96;⚠️ Filtering out future date: ${dateStr} (year ${year})&#96;);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tvalue: dateStr,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcount: 0, // Set count to 0 to exclude from visualizations\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// If we got a very old year (like 196 instead of 1996 or 2196)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// assume it's a modern date missing the millennium\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif (year \u003c 1000) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Determine if this should be 1900s or 2000s based on the original 2-digit year\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlet correctedYear;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif (year \u003c 70) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcorrectedYear = 2000 + year; - 
+ ---
+ description: Standardize human-readable date formatting and documentation metadata (authorship vs repo-added) across the project
+ globs: **/*.md, **/*.mdc, **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}
+ alwaysApply: false
+ ---
+ 
+ - **Human‑Readable Date Format (UI/Docs)**
+   - Use: "June 12th 2005" (token pattern: &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;)
+   - Ordinal day required (&#96;1st&#96;, &#96;2nd&#96;, &#96;3rd&#96;, &#96;4th&#96;, ...)
+   - Prefer locale &#96;en-US&#96;
+ 
+ - **Machine/Metadata Date Format**
+   - Use ISO 8601 UTC: &#96;YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ&#96; (e.g., &#96;2025-06-12T00:00:00Z&#96;)
+   - Front matter fields for docs: &#96;created&#96;, &#96;lastUpdated&#96;
+   - Do not store ordinals in metadata; ordinals are display-only
+ 
+ - **Semantics: Created vs Added to Repo**
+   - **Created (authorship)**: the document’s authoring date (front matter/header)
+   - **Added to Repo**: earliest Git author date for the file (first commit adding it)
+   - When communicating dates, prefer authorship for content provenance, and explicitly note repo-added when relevant to VCS history
+ 
+ - **Approved Libraries/Patterns**
+   - &#96;date-fns&#96; UI formatting: &#96;format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy')&#96;
+   - &#96;dayjs&#96; (if already present in the module) with &#96;advancedFormat&#96; plugin: &#96;dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY')&#96;
+   - Avoid raw &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat&#96; for ordinals (no native ordinal support)
+ 
+ - **Code Examples (update existing patterns)**
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+   // date-fns (Before → After)
+   import { format } from 'date-fns'
+   const before = format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy')
+   const after  = format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy') // "June 12th 2005"
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+   // dayjs with advancedFormat (only where dayjs is already used)
+   import dayjs from 'dayjs'
+   import advancedFormat from 'dayjs/plugin/advancedFormat'
+   dayjs.extend(advancedFormat)
+   const s = dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY') // "June 12th 2005"
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ - **Front Matter Template (Markdown)**
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml
+   ---
+   title: My Document
+   description: Short purpose statement
+   created: 2025-06-12T00:00:00Z
+   lastUpdated: 2025-08-08T00:00:00Z
+   author: Your Name
+   version: 1.0.0
+   ---
+   &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ - **Display Guidance**
+   - Render human-readable dates from ISO metadata at runtime using the approved patterns
+   - Do not hardcode display strings if the ISO value is available
+ 
+ - **Existing References in Repo**
+   - Intl (no ordinals): [map-utils.ts](mdc:apps/app/src/features/data-viz/sightings/utils/map-utils.ts)
+   - date-fns long format (no ordinals): [graph-card.tsx](mdc:apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/cards/graph-card/graph-card.tsx), [topic-card.tsx](mdc:apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/cards/topic-card.tsx)
+   - dayjs short numeric: [graph-node-card.tsx](mdc:apps/app/src/components/ui/card/graph-node-card.tsx)
+   - Mixed numeric formats: [grid-card.tsx](mdc:apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/cards/event/grid-card.tsx)
